events.title: Open Weights Capability Jump
events.description: An open-weight release lands within a few months of the closed frontier. It is downloaded hundreds of thousands of times in the first week, and whatever capability it carries is now on private hardware permanently and beyond recall. `openweight_capability` moves to within 5–10 points of `ai_capability` at a stroke.

events.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
events.description: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion. Nothing that has not happened before, at a scale that is slightly harder to dismiss. **This is a precursor: it opens the Taiwan gate for the next 3 turns.**

events.title: emergent_intrusion_tooling_copycats
events.description: Forensic samples of the autumn industrial-intrusion tooling leak publicly and are repackaged into copycat intrusion kits, triggering a wave of low-skill probes against European municipal utilities and grid suppliers.
